summary: Master Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs). Learn to structure commercial terms, allocate IPP risks, and manage energy offtake contracts. Enroll today.
lede: Power purchase agreement training covers how utility commercial teams and project developers structure and administer long-term electricity offtake contracts. It is for utility commercial teams, project developers, energy regulators and infrastructure lenders, with practice in modeling tariff charges, designing payment security, and assessing generation, curtailment and contract risks.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for professionals managing the commercial, regulatory, and financial dimensions of power sector transactions.
modules: PPA Foundations and Electricity Market Structures
Dispatch Rules, Curtailment, and Grid Integration
Force Majeure, Change in Law, and Dispute Resolution
PPA Negotiation Strategy and Stakeholder Alignment
prerequisites: Working knowledge of energy sector fundamentals or infrastructure finance is expected. Basic familiarity with spreadsheet software is recommended for tariff calculation exercises. No advanced legal drafting or complex financial modeling experience is required.
